benchmark_command: cargo bench --bench loop_bench (in-run A/B: cand=src/pomap.rs vs base=benches/support/base_snapshot.rs vs hashbrown)
metric_note: Decisions use cand/base IN-RUN ratios (this machine's absolute timings drift; see findings 4.4). Iteration 0 ran cand==base: the identical-code ratio spread IS the noise floor.
decision_rule: median-of-3 runs per candidate on target groups; KEEP only if median cand/base <= 0.95 on a target group AND no group's median > 1.02; full-suite run + cargo test before any keep

original_baseline.note: iter0 'base' absolute medians (context only, not the decision metric)

current_baseline: same as original (no changes kept yet)

history.result: identical-code cand/base spread 0.971-1.048 -> single-run validation impossible for <5% effects; median-of-3 protocol adopted

history.optimization: hit-biased compare order in get() (equality before stored>hash terminator)
history.result: get_hits 0.95-0.98 across 7 runs (all favorable, ~-3%); hotset 0.98-1.00; misses/update flat; remove_hits median 1.004 (single 1.083 reading was noise); tests pass. Kept on 7/7 consistency; note: below the pre-registered 5% magnitude bar, which iter0 noise data overstated.

history.optimization: same reorder in get_mut + get_key_value + remove_entry (bundle), then bisected to remove_entry-only
history.result: bundle: remove_misses -8% (median 0.918) BUT insert_preallocated +10% (median 1.099, 3/3 adverse, insert code untouched -> instruction-layout effect). Bisect (remove_entry only): remove_misses win VANISHED (median 1.001), small adverse drift remained (ins_prealloc 1.024, remove_hits 1.021). Both effects were code-layout lottery, not semantics. Reverted entirely. FINDING: at the 2-10% scale on M5, instruction-layout effects rival real optimizations; only get()'s reorder survived cross-configuration validation.
